changelog: Recover exact studio tracks hidden by karaoke/type-beat keyword results using bounded title-only and verified artist catalogue searches.
Fix saved metadata-only requests such as i need u by Ken Carson; retain source family and provider IDs.
Cap search/playback recovery at eight requests and 7.5 seconds; preserve title/artist/version checks and reject changed detail duration/ISRC.
Prefer HTTPS audio alternatives; do not cache empty artist responses; no new provider or server deployment is included.
Manifest offline permission retained; older app binaries need the matching exact-package approval before new offline downloads are allowed.
Exact-artist catalogue search with real song/release pagination and artist-credit validation; collaborations retained.
Source-owned release cards and album tracks; unknown release types remain unclassified, not certified official albums.
Playback resolution and Smart Radio handlers unchanged from 1.4.2; staged for matching app/device testing.
Strict recording identity: exact provider IDs, Unicode-safe matching, bounded candidate search; no opaque-ID recursion.
Genuine source suggestions exposed via music_radio_v1 (Smart Radio) and related tracks; honest failures instead of filler.
Runtime concurrency capped at one operation; album and home endpoints unchanged.
Fixed seek bar and stream duration resolution.
Unified high-fidelity music search and 320kbps full-length stream resolution.
Added in-module DES-ECB cipher hardware decryption for direct Akamai CDN MP4 audio.
Added multi-mirror failover and automatic base64 catalogue track decoding.

presentation.purpose: Gateway playback with verified bounded catalogue recovery

changelog: Provider-qualified IDs (freefy:yt: / freefy:saavn:); legacy ambiguous IDs fail with a refresh message instead of guessing.
Removed recursive first-result substitution and the fake "similar music" related search; no implied YouTube playback.
Worldwide YouTube Music search aggregator integration.
High-fidelity 320kbps full-length playback with mirror fallbacks.
Offline playback support.

presentation.purpose: YouTube metadata search; verified JioSaavn playback only

changelog: Verifies returned recording identity (Apple ID, file/track ID, ISRC) and rejects mismatches instead of relabelling wrong audio.
Exposes actual provider title/artist/album/duration/ISRC for app-side validation; preserves only paired response headers.
Remains an optional secondary source; single-page search by design.
Full-length stream resolution verified to 120 MB continuous (24-bit/88.2 kHz FLAC) through the community resolver instance.
Apple Music catalogue search with Qobuz-first stream resolution.
No credentials required; offline download disabled; honest failure paths.
YouTube Music search via InnerTube (WEB_REMIX).
Playback guarded: detects YouTube's unsigned-stream restriction and reports it honestly; recovers automatically when lifted.
